card.title: PS5 EMC error codes: GDDR6 RAM (8080110x–8080111F)

claims.statement: PS5 errors 80801101–8080111F flag GDDR6 RAM chips as a bitmask in the last digits: bit 1 = RAM 1 (…01), 2 = RAM 2 (…02), 4 = RAM 3 (…04), 8 = RAM 4 (…08), 0x10 = RAM 5 (…10); e.g. 80801103 = RAM 1 and 2, 8080111F = RAM 1–5.
808011A0 = GDDR6 banks 6 and 8, seen with a single beep, 1 s blue light, then off.
80000024 is listed as a MEMIO(2) init failure on the SoC (uncertain).

procedure: Decode the low bits of 808011xx to the flagged RAM chip(s).
Check those RAM chips' rails/joints; reball or replace.
card.caveats: Bitmask decoding inferred from the listed sequence; chip numbering follows the source. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
